lines.speaker: Gable
lines.text: Welcome to Brickbloom Heights, traveller! Bring three Star Shards home and the castle's blocks will stack themselves into a stair up the Star Turret.

lines.speaker: Gable
lines.text: Warp pipes join the high and low parts of the kingdom. Plunge into one, or stand on top and press E.

lines.speaker: Gable
lines.text: Some bricks hide Glimmer Seeds; the ones that glint, mostly. Jump and bonk them from below!
